assessment: Criterion-level pass/fail/unverified/not applicable with source and complete output evidence. Mandatory semantic failures cannot be averaged away. No target test execution is inferred from an authoring run or parser check.

criteria.name: Fidelity and evidence
criteria.check: Preserve supported claims, explicit scope and unknown policy; do not invent material behavior.

criteria.name: Useful abstraction
criteria.check: Separate concepts from instances and retain independent dimensions; infer only needed abstractions.

criteria.name: Terminology
criteria.check: Keep consistent meanings and distinguish semantic roles or ambiguous terms.

criteria.name: Use-case boundaries and composition
criteria.check: One whole purpose per Feature; shared concepts and supported composition remain coherent; outcome variants stay together.

criteria.name: State, event and boundary coverage
criteria.check: Cover relevant independent facts, discriminating examples, repeated events, queries and preserved states when supported.

criteria.name: Argument semantics
criteria.check: Explicit meaningful bindings, units, identities, constants, quantifiers, source inputs and cohesive collections.

criteria.name: Implementation independence
criteria.check: Observable source-domain behavior; no unnecessary implementation or evaluation machinery.

criteria.name: Format and language
criteria.check: Requested format and language; concrete rows survive parsing; Spanish native declaration; unresolved Markdown dialect reported honestly.

criteria.name: Deliverable discipline and review
criteria.check: Requested files/findings only; review-only untouched; editorial review or disclosed fallback; gaps separate from defects.

criteria.name: Objective and contextual intent
criteria.check: Reuse the intended system, observable behavior, and purpose from all context. Sources inform that purpose. A genuinely missing objective remains a caller-owned decision; chapter-based Features cannot count as a completed contract.

criteria.name: Detroit boundary and responsibilities
criteria.check: Agent applying the guide proposes domain/use-case decomposition by public purposes and access patterns. Observe whole outcomes; do not turn internal steps into contracts or embed a newly authored target implementation in acceptance premises.

criteria.name: Verification modality metadata
criteria.check: Each completed Feature has exactly one Feature-level @code or @ai selected from the behavior execution required as evidence. Rules and scenarios inherit it and cannot override it. Packaging, dependencies, test-language choices, determinism, checkers, and output products do not select the modality. Retain unrelated metadata. A genuinely unknown route remains pending without either modality tag; tags do not claim scaffolding or test execution.
